universe: config/watchlist.json buckets (core equity, aggressive growth, sector momentum, crypto, penny lab, defensive)
entry_rule: composite multifactor score >= confidence_buy_threshold (0.50, adaptive within [0.30,0.70]) with market-regime multiplier and cross-asset relative-strength tilt
exit_rule: ATR trailing stop; breakeven+0.5% after +3%; take-profit at entry + ATR*tp_mult (sell 50%); or composite score <= confidence_exit_threshold
signal_bar: t (decision computed from bars[:t+1], close of day t)
sizing: max_loss_per_trade = equity * 1%; shares = max_loss / (ATR * stop_mult); position_size_multiplier adaptive within [0.5,1.5]; hardcoded caps in config/risk_limits.json are never relaxed
benchmark: buy & hold SPY with identical friction
notes: Formalized contract for P1's live multifactor engine. fees/slippage are the documented default; calibrated friction (data/fee_source.json) overrides advisorily and is floored at the default. This spec is the front door for any self-learning knob change.
